{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "请列出所有用户注册日期所在月份（格式为'YYYY-MM'），以及当月注册的用户总数和其中VIP用户数量，按月份升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "按 users.register_date 的年月分组（YYYY-MM），统计每组 COUNT(*) 和 SUM(CASE WHEN is_vip=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)，结果按年月字符串升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.register_date_month:count_total_count_vip:order_by_month_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DATE_FORMAT(register_date, '%Y-%m') AS register_month, COUNT(*) AS total_users, SUM(CASE WHEN is_vip = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vip_users FROM users GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(register_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY register_month ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请返回每个用户等级（user_level）对应的平均注册天数距参考日2026-09-12的天数（即DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', register_date)的平均值），保留2位小数，并按用户等级升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对 users 表按 user_level 分组，计算每组中 DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', register_date) 的 AVG()，四舍五入至2位小数；结果按 user_level 字典升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.user_level:avg_days_since_register_to_20260912:order_by_user_level_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT user_level, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', register_date)), 2) AS avg_days_since_register FROM users GROUP BY user_level ORDER BY user_level ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出所有注册日期在2025年及之后的用户中，不同性别与用户等级的组合（gender + user_level），以及对应组合的用户数量，按用户数量降序、再按用户等级升序、最后按性别升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "筛选 register_date >= '2025-01-01' 的用户，按 gender 和 user_level 联合分组，统计 COUNT(*)；排序规则：先按数量 DESC，再按 user_level ASC，最后按 gender ASC。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.gender_user_level:count_after_2025:order_by_count_desc_user_level_asc_gender_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT gender, user_level, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE register_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY gender, user_level ORDER BY user_count DESC, user_level ASC, gender ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请返回所有用户的注册年份（register_date 的 YEAR），以及该年注册的男性用户数、女性用户数、未知性别用户数（gender 为空或非'男'/'女'者计为未知），按年份升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "按 YEAR(register_date) 分组，分别统计 gender='男'、gender='女'、其余（含 NULL 或其他值）的用户数量；结果按年份升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.register_year:count_male_female_unknown:order_by_year_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT YEAR(register_date) AS register_year, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = '男' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = '女' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count, SUM(CASE WHEN gender NOT IN ('男', '女') OR gender IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_count FROM users GROUP BY YEAR(register_date) ORDER BY register_year ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出注册时间最早和最晚的5位用户（按register_date升序取前5，降序取前5），返回其user_name、register_date和user_level，共10行，且全部结果按register_date升序排列。",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "取 register_date 最小的5条记录和最大的5条记录（不合并去重），输出 user_name、register_date、user_level；最终10行统一按 register_date 升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.user_name_register_date_user_level:top5_earliest_and_latest:order_by_register_date_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT user_name, register_date, user_level FROM (SELECT user_name, register_date, user_level FROM users ORDER BY register_date ASC LIMIT 5 UNION ALL SELECT user_name, register_date, user_level FROM users ORDER BY register_date DESC LIMIT 5) t ORDER BY register_date ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请统计每个用户等级（user_level）中，注册于工作日（周一至周五）和周末（周六、周日）的用户数量，返回字段为user_level、weekday_count、weekend_count，按user_level升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "按 user_level 分组；用 DAYOFWEEK(register_date) 判定：2–6为工作日（周一=2），1/7为周末；分别求和；输出三列，按 user_level 升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.user_level:count_weekday_weekend:order_by_user_level_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT user_level, SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(register_date) IN (2,3,4,5,6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count, SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(register_date) IN (1,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count FROM users GROUP BY user_level ORDER BY user_level ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请返回所有注册日期在2024年全年的用户中，各城市的用户总数和其中VIP用户占比（小数点后4位），按城市名称升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "筛选 register_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' 的用户；按 city 分组；统计 COUNT(*) 和 ROUND(AVG(is_vip),4)；结果按 city 升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.city:count_total_rate_vip_2024:order_by_city_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS total_users, ROUND(AVG(is_vip), 4) AS vip_rate FROM users WHERE register_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY city ORDER BY city ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出所有用户中，注册间隔（相邻用户按register_date升序排列的差值，单位：天）大于30天的全部间隔值（即LAG(register_date)与当前register_date之差），返回该差值（正整数）和对应后一用户的user_name，最多100行，按差值降序排列。",
      "category": "time",
      "difficulty": "hard",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对 users 按 register_date ASC 排序，用 LAG() 计算前一行 register_date，得到 diff = DATEDIFF(register_date, prev_date)；筛选 diff > 30；输出 diff 和当前行 user_name；最多100行，按 diff DESC。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.register_gap_gt30:user_name_diff:order_by_diff_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DATEDIFF(register_date, prev_date) AS gap_days, user_name FROM (SELECT user_name, register_date, LAG(register_date) OVER (ORDER BY register_date ASC) AS prev_date FROM users) t WHERE DATEDIFF(register_date, prev_date) > 30 ORDER BY gap_days DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请返回所有用户中，注册日期为当月1号的用户数量，以及其中用户等级为gold或black的用户数量，仅返回这两项数值，不带列名。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "COUNT(*) 所有 register_date 是当月1号（即 DAY(register_date)=1）的用户；COUNT(*) 其中 user_level IN ('gold','black')；仅返回两个整数，无列别名，无排序。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.count_first_day_and_gold_black",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(CASE WHEN user_level IN ('gold', 'black') THEN 1 END) FROM users WHERE DAY(register_date) = 1;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出所有用户等级（user_level）中，注册于2026年8月的用户数量，以及这些用户中性别为'男'的比例（小数点后4位），按用户等级升序排列。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "筛选 register_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' 的用户；按 user_level 分组；统计 COUNT(*) 和 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gender='男' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4)；按 user_level 升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "users.user_level:count_aug2026_male_rate:order_by_user_level_asc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT user_level, COUNT(*) AS aug2026_users, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gender = '男' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS male_rate FROM users WHERE register_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY user_level ORDER BY user_level ASC;",
      "ordered": true
    }
  ]
}
